messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT for service=auth-rate-limiter - sudden spike in Redis Cloud connection resets (us-east-1). 5xx increase from 0.2% -> 6.8% over last 3m. Key metric: rate-limiter miss-rate + auth latency. Link: https://grafana.internal/redash/d/abcd/auth-rate-limiter?orgId=1

maria.sre: I'm oncall, grabbing this. paging PD now. can someone post the rediscloud status link?

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident 78912 triggered and routed to maria.sre. Acknowledged by maria.sre at 2026-03-15 18:20:18 UTC.

samir.platform: seeing lots of `ECONNRESET` in the rate-limiter logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:19:12Z rate-limiter ERROR redis connection reset: read tcp 10.12.4.5:6379: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T18:19:13Z rate-limiter WARN cache-miss fallback to remote lookup
```

maria.sre: thanks. I'm testing toggling the in-memory fallback to reduce external calls. will also flip circuit-breaker to force short-circuit for writes.

samir.platform: +1. config snippet to enable fallback: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/rate-limiter ENABLE_INMEM_FALLBACK=true CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD=5`

elaine-support: pinged support rotations and prepping customer note. Template ready: "We are investigating degraded authentication performance for customers in US-East. Mitigation in progress; no sustained data loss." Will send once we have ETA.

rediscloud-status-bot: Update from Redis Cloud: "Investigating — intermittent connection resets affecting peering connections from several customers in us-east-1. Root cause under investigation." status.redislabs.com/incident/xyz (we're listed).

maria.sre: executed fallback: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/rate-limiter ENABLE_INMEM_FALLBACK=true` -> rollout ok. Also patched circuit breaker: `kubectl -n prod patch configmap rl-config -p '{"data":{"circuit_breaker":"tripped"}}'`

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rediscloud-connection-resets. Suggested next steps: 1) enable fallback 2) increase cache TTL for local memoization 3) open support ticket with Redis Cloud and request peering check.

samir.platform: increased local TTLs: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api CACHE_TTL=30s` to reduce lookups. Doing smoke tests now.

maria.sre: smoke test: auth requests succeed locally for most flows, 95th p90 latency improved but still seeing intermittent 502s on long flows. Current metrics: auth-5xx rate lowered from 6.8% -> 1.4% after fallback.

elaine-support: sending customers the initial notification now (small set of impacted orgs). Template: "We're seeing elevated auth latencies and intermittent failures affecting token ops. We're mitigating by routing to local cache; we'll follow up with root cause once provider confirms."

rediscloud-status-bot: Update: "We have identified flaps on the peering fabric — engineering applying network remediation. ETA unknown. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."

maria.sre: opened ticket with RedisCloud (ticket RC-45213) with logs + pcap snippets. Requesting they validate peering filters.

kevin.oncall: @maria.sre taking next shift in 25m. please capture runbook steps and any outstanding actions.

maria.sre: handing off: summary -> cause: upstream peering intermittency causing connection resets to our managed Redis instances in us-east-1; mitigation -> enabled in-memory fallback, tripped circuit breaker, increased local TTLs; impact -> auth latency spike and some 5xxs for ~25% of auth token exchanges before mitigation, now reduced to ~1-2%; customer notif -> initial messages sent to affected customers; ticket -> RC-45213 with RedisCloud; observability -> dashboards pinned here: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/auth-rate-limiter.

maria.sre: outstanding: need to monitor for 1hr post-handoff, confirm RedisCloud fix, and revert flags when stable. also verify no cache incoherency for critical flows. I've left the feature flag on for safety.

kevin.oncall: ack. I'll be on watch from 18:45-19:30 UTC. If RedisCloud posts resolution, I'll coordinate rollback of ENABLE_INMEM_FALLBACK and CICRUIT_BREAKER reset. Also will ensure support follow-up to customers. :thumbsup:

rediscloud-status-bot: Update: "Mitigation applied to peering fabric; connection resets dropping. Monitoring for stabilization."

maria.sre: seeing connections stabilize in our metrics. good to see p95 auth latency near baseline. leaving note in incident tracker.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-rc-connreset. Severity: Sev2. Owner: maria.sre -> handoff to kevin.oncall.

kevin.oncall: closing loop - will watch for 1hr and then close if stable. will post postmortem draft if provider confirms root cause.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Reminder scheduled for escalation check in 30 minutes.

elaine-support: once we have confirmation from rediscloud, i'll send the follow-up customer note with timeline and mitigation steps.

maria.sre: thanks team. handing off Slack thread to @kevin.oncall. :wave:
